Agent onboarding: signup URL, auto-created key, free-credit budget and the 402 top-up path. Attribution links refreshed.

Initial release – access Threads profiles, posts, replies, and users via the Scavio API.

- Provides 6 endpoints: Threads profile, user posts, user replies, single post, post comments, and user (people) search.
- Supports queries by user_id (2 credits) or username/handle (4 credits); explains cost and recommends reusing user_id to save credits.
- Includes pagination for posts, replies, and comments; search and profile endpoints are not paginated.
- Only allows people search—no content, topic, or hashtag searching.
- Detailed usage instructions, parameter documentation, and Python code examples included.
